prompts.prompt_text: Build an original product ad with a two-second problem hook, a clear product reveal, one credible demonstration, proof, and a clean CTA hero frame. Keep product geometry and label placement consistent across shots.
prompts.negative_prompt: no watermark, no random logo, no identity drift, no unreadable text
prompts.license_note: Original internal template; reusable with transformation.

prompts.prompt_text: Create an affiliate short with an honest problem hook, hands-on demonstration, one limitation, three benefits, and a non-pushy CTA. Use original footage language and verifiable claims only.
prompts.negative_prompt: no fake testimonial, no guaranteed income claim, no watermark

prompts.prompt_text: A natural handheld UGC shot with one speaker, realistic room light, subtle phone-camera movement, credible product interaction, stable face and hands, and conversational pacing.
prompts.negative_prompt: no beauty-filter face drift, no extra fingers, no brand hallucination, no watermark

prompts.prompt_text: Plan an original cinematic arc with setup, tension, turning point, resolution, controlled camera grammar, motivated lighting, and strict character continuity between scenes.
prompts.negative_prompt: no living-artist imitation, no copyrighted character, no continuity drift, no watermark
prompts.license_note: Original internal template; no artist or franchise imitation.

prompts.prompt_text: Create a cute original 3D character story with a fixed character bible, readable silhouette, warm expressions, simple environments, and one clear action per panel.
prompts.negative_prompt: no copyrighted mascot, no character redesign between panels, no watermark
prompts.license_note: Original internal template; original characters only.

prompts.prompt_text: Build suspense through negative space, motivated practical light, restrained camera movement, off-screen sound cues, and an original reveal without graphic harm.
prompts.negative_prompt: no gore, no copyrighted monster, no strobing, no watermark

prompts.prompt_text: Design grounded action with clear screen direction, one readable movement beat per shot, safe spatial continuity, motivated cuts, and physically plausible motion.
prompts.negative_prompt: no impossible anatomy, no teleporting subject, no excessive camera shake, no watermark

prompts.prompt_text: Preserve source identity, body/object proportions, pose direction, timing, and foreground interaction while transforming only the approved background, lighting, and art direction.
prompts.negative_prompt: no identity change, no pose reversal, no object replacement, no watermark
prompts.license_note: Original internal template; user must own source media rights.

prompts.prompt_text: Animate the supplied image with subtle parallax, one controlled camera move, natural secondary motion, stable subject geometry, fixed brand details, and a clean end frame.
prompts.negative_prompt: no image redesign, no morphing, no new logo, no flicker, no watermark
prompts.license_note: Original internal template; user must own image rights.

prompts.prompt_text: Create nine sequential panels with one action beat each, fixed character/product canon, camera angle, lighting, transition, and matching image/video prompt per panel.
prompts.negative_prompt: no panel duplication, no continuity drift, no watermark, no random text

prompts.prompt_text: Create twelve sequential panels with setup, escalation, payoff, fixed visual canon, clear shot duration, transition, and provider-ready motion prompt for every panel.
prompts.negative_prompt: no panel duplication, no continuity drift, no watermark, no random text

prompts.prompt_text: Group consecutive shots in batches of two. Each batch states shot timing, shared visual canon, start frame, end frame, camera move, transition, and continuity handoff without unsupported provider parameters.
prompts.negative_prompt: no unsupported flags, no identity drift, no temporal jump, no watermark
prompts.license_note: Original provider-neutral template inspired by multishot workflow concepts.

prompts.prompt_text: Generate ten original Short ideas with a curiosity hook, one useful takeaway, a visual format, and a concise CTA appropriate to the audience.
prompts.negative_prompt: no fake statistic, no copied creator format, no misleading claim

prompts.prompt_text: Generate ten original two-second hooks using curiosity, demonstration, contrast, or a specific audience problem; avoid copied catchphrases and unverifiable claims.
prompts.negative_prompt: no copied trend script, no fake claim, no spam CTA

prompts.prompt_text: Create an original Facebook ad plan with a clear audience problem, product demonstration, verified benefit, readable silent-first composition, and a restrained CTA.
prompts.negative_prompt: no prohibited claim, no fake before-after, no watermark, no unreadable overlay
